about_formats.title: What is SVG?
about_formats.text: SVG is a vector image format that scales without losing quality, ideal for icons and illustrations.

about_formats.title: What is PNG?
about_formats.text: PNG is a raster image format widely used for web graphics, screenshots, and digital images.

about_formats.title: What is SVG format?
about_formats.text: SVG is an XML-based vector format known for its scalability and small file size.

about_formats.title: What is PNG format?
about_formats.text: PNG is a popular raster format chosen for its lossless compression and broad compatibility.
